records.jp: あ、その辺適当に座って
records.en_original: Oh, feel free to sit wherever.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, feel free to sit wherever.
records.en: Oh, feel free to sit wherever.

records.jp: なんか飲むー？
records.en_original: Want something to drink?
records.en_auxiliary: Want something to drink?
records.en: Want something to drink?

records.jp: いえ、お構いなく
records.en_original: No, thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: No, thank you.
records.en: No, thank you.

records.jp: どう？　こっちの教室は
records.en_original: Well, what do you think of our classroom?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, what do you think of our classroom?
records.en: Well, what do you think of our classroom?

records.jp: 片づけたくなります
records.en_original: I want to clean it up.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to clean it up.
records.en: I want to clean it up.

records.jp: やっぱかー。<CR>片づけてくれてもいいのよ？
records.en_original: That bad? You know, if you wanted clean it up for me, I wouldn't mind?
records.en_auxiliary: That bad? You know, if you wanted clean it up for me, I wouldn't mind?
records.en: I knew it.<CR>You are welcome to clean it up for us, you know?

records.jp: 嫌です
records.en_original: Not in a million years.
records.en_auxiliary: Not in a million years.
records.en: Not in a million years.

records.jp: あはは
records.en_original: Ahaha!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha!
records.en: Ahaha!

records.jp: でも、居心地は悪くないです。<CR>こっちの部屋に移るのもいいですね
records.en_original: It may be a bit messy, but it's quite comfy. I wouldn't mind staying here.
records.en_auxiliary: It may be a bit messy, but it's quite comfy. I wouldn't mind staying here.
records.en: Still, it is not uncomfortable.<CR>Moving into this room might be nice too.

records.jp: ダメだよ、詩帆さんはこっちの空気に染まっちゃ。<CR>ほどほどのところで出よっか
records.en_original: Wait, Shiho. You can't. You'll be infected by our messiness. We should take things slow.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Shiho. You can't. You'll be infected by our messiness. We should take things slow.
records.en: No, Shiho-san. You cannot let this room rub off on you.<CR>We should leave before it is too late.

records.jp: そんなこと言わずに。<CR>私、この部屋の人たちの面倒みますよ
records.en_original: Don't say that. I'd take care of everyone in this room.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't say that. I'd take care of everyone in this room.
records.en: Do not say that.<CR>I will look after everyone in this room.

records.jp: 掃除もしますし、おやつも出します。<CR>むしろ私たちの教室は常に綺麗で張り合いがなくて……
records.en_original: I would clean and prepare snacks for everybody. Our room is so clean it's a little disappointing.
records.en_auxiliary: I would clean and prepare snacks for everybody. Our room is so clean it's a little disappointing.
records.en: I will clean and serve snacks too.<CR>Our classroom is always so spotless that there is no challenge in it...

records.jp: それはさらに私たちが堕落する！
records.en_original: That would just make us sink deeper into our depravity!
records.en_auxiliary: That would just make us sink deeper into our depravity!
records.en: That would just make us sink deeper into our depravity!

records.jp: 一緒に怠惰になろうよ～
records.en_original: We can revel in sloth together!
records.en_auxiliary: We can revel in sloth together!
records.en: We can revel in sloth together!

records.jp: お菓子とかゲームとか、色々あるよ～
records.en_original: We've got junk food, and video games. All sorts of stuff!
records.en_auxiliary: We've got junk food, and video games. All sorts of stuff!
records.en: We've got junk food, and video games. All sorts of stuff!

records.jp: あはは、たまにはそうするのもいいですね。<CR>でも、時間はちゃんと区切らないと
records.en_original: Ahaha, those are fine in moderation, but you should be sure to separate your time well.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, those are fine in moderation, but you should be sure to separate your time well.
records.en: Ahaha, doing that once in a while would be nice.<CR>But we must set a proper limit on the time.

records.jp: 休憩は働くためにあるんですから
records.en_original: Breaks are there for us to recharge from work after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Breaks are there for us to recharge from work after all.
records.en: Breaks exist so that we can work, after all.

records.jp: 偉いなあ……そんな考え方できないよ
records.en_original: So adult... I don't think I could think like that even if I tried.
records.en_auxiliary: So adult... I don't think I could think like that even if I tried.
records.en: So adult... I don't think I could think like that even if I tried.

records.jp: 詩帆さん、いつもせっせと働いてるよね。<CR>こういうときぐらい、気を緩めたら？
records.en_original: You're always so diligent, Shiho. Why don't you loosen up a bit. Just this once.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always so diligent, Shiho. Why don't you loosen up a bit. Just this once.
records.en: You are always working so hard, Shiho-san.<CR>Why not let yourself relax at a time like this?

records.jp: そうですね……ではお言葉に甘えますね
records.en_original: I suppose you're right... Don't mind if I do.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose you're right... Don't mind if I do.
records.en: I suppose you're right... Don't mind if I do.

records.jp: すー。すー
records.en_original: *zzz*
records.en_auxiliary: *zzz*
records.en: *zzz*

records.jp: （あれ、詩帆さん寝てる？）
records.en_original: (Oh? She fell asleep?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh? She fell asleep?)
records.en: (Huh? Is Shiho-san asleep?)

records.jp: 詩帆さーん
records.en_original: Hey, Shihooooo!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Shihooooo!
records.en: Hey, Shihooooo!

records.jp: はっ
records.en_original: Ahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh!
records.en: Ahh!

records.jp: ごめんなさい、急いで朝ごはん作ります！
records.en_original: I'm sorry, I'll start preparing breakfast right away!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, I'll start preparing breakfast right away!
records.en: I am sorry! I will hurry and make breakfast!

records.jp: 慌てないで！<CR>教室で昼寝してただけだよ
records.en_original: Calm down! You were just taking a nap in the classroom.
records.en_auxiliary: Calm down! You were just taking a nap in the classroom.
records.en: Do not panic!<CR>You were only napping in the classroom.

records.jp: あ……そうでした。<CR>てっきり校内放送を聞き逃したのかと
records.en_original: Ah... You're right. I thought I had slept through the morning announcement.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... You're right. I thought I had slept through the morning announcement.
records.en: Ah... that is right.<CR>I thought I had slept through the school announcement.

records.jp: それにしても、別に朝ごはんが無かったくらいで<CR>怒らないのに
records.en_original: Even so, it's not like anyone would get mad at you for not making breakfast.
records.en_auxiliary: Even so, it's not like anyone would get mad at you for not making breakfast.
records.en: Even so, no one would be angry<CR>just because there was no breakfast.

records.jp: わたしがわたしを許せないんです。<CR>健康的な毎日を送りたいじゃないですか
records.en_original: Oh, it's not that. I would be angry with myself. Waking up bright and early is an important part of healthy living.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, it's not that. I would be angry with myself. Waking up bright and early is an important part of healthy living.
records.en: I would not be able to forgive myself.<CR>We all want to live healthy lives each day, do we not?

records.jp: （意外と頑固なところがあるんだな）
records.en_original: (She's so stubborn about stuff like this...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's so stubborn about stuff like this...)
records.en: (She is surprisingly stubborn about things like this.)

records.jp: （やっぱり疲れてたんだな。しばらく寝てもらおう）
records.en_original: (She must be tired. I should let her sleep.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She must be tired. I should let her sleep.)
records.en: (She must be tired. I should let her sleep.)

records.jp: すー。すー
records.en_original: *zzz*
records.en_auxiliary: *zzz*
records.en: *zzz*

records.jp: （寝てる時も行儀良いんだなぁ）
records.en_original: (She's so prim and proper, even when she's asleep...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's so prim and proper, even when she's asleep...)
records.en: (Even when she sleeps, she is so well-behaved.)

records.jp: すー。すー
records.en_original: *zzz*
records.en_auxiliary: *zzz*
records.en: *zzz*

records.jp: （なんかいたずらしたくなってきたな）
records.en_original: (I kinda wanna tease her...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I kinda wanna tease her...)
records.en: (I kinda wanna tease her...)

records.jp: はっ
records.en_original: Ahh!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh!
records.en: Ahh!

records.jp: ど、どうかしましたか？
records.en_original: Wh-what is it?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what is it?
records.en: Wh-what is it?

records.jp: いやー、なんにも？
records.en_original: Uhhh... Nothing?
records.en_auxiliary: Uhhh... Nothing?
records.en: Uhhh... Nothing?

records.jp: そろそろ移動する？<CR>ずっとここにいるのもなんだし
records.en_original: Shall we head out? We've been here for a while.
records.en_auxiliary: Shall we head out? We've been here for a while.
records.en: Shall we head out?<CR>We've been here for a while.

records.jp: え～？　まだよくないですか～？
records.en_original: Aww... Do we have to?
records.en_auxiliary: Aww... Do we have to?
records.en: Aww~? Cannot we stay a little longer~?

records.en_original: (Hm?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hm?)
records.en: (Hm?)

records.jp: もうちょっとゆっくりしましょうよ～
records.en_original: Can't we relax for a little while longer?
records.en_auxiliary: Can't we relax for a little while longer?
records.en: Let us relax a little longer~

records.jp: （あれ、もしかしてこっちの教室に染められてる？）
records.en_original: (Oh no. Did we infect her with our laziness?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh no. Did we infect her with our laziness?)
records.en: (Wait, is this room already rubbing off on her?)

records.jp: 詩帆さん、しっかりして！
records.en_original: Shiho! Get it together!
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho! Get it together!
records.en: Shiho-san! Get it together!

records.jp: 移動しましょうか！
records.en_original: Let's get going, shall we?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get going, shall we?
records.en: Let's get going, shall we?

records.jp: 危ないところだった……
records.en_original: That was a close one...
records.en_auxiliary: That was a close one...
records.en: That was a close one...

records.jp: （そのまま見守ってみよう。<CR>寝ぼけてるだけかもしれないし）
records.en_original: (I should keep an eye on her. I think she's still half-asleep.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I should keep an eye on her. I think she's still half-asleep.)
records.en: (I should keep watching her like this.<CR>She may only be half-asleep.)

records.jp: （このままだとまた寝ちゃうんじゃ……）
records.en_original: (She looks like she'll fall asleep again if I let...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She looks like she'll fall asleep again if I let...)
records.en: (She looks like she'll fall asleep again if I let...)

records.jp: （まぁ、こんなふうに過ごす時間があってもいいよね）
records.en_original: (Guess this is as good a way to spend time as any.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Guess this is as good a way to spend time as any.)
records.en: (It is fine to spend time like this once in a while.)
